title: notify-cluster-5 overloaded — push notification service 504
description: The NotifyHub push notification service started returning 504 Gateway Timeout errors at 15:30 UTC. Monitoring confirms notify-cluster-5 in ap-southeast-1 is overloaded and not processing new notification jobs. Mobile users are not receiving critical alerts. Escalation needed.

title: notification-worker pod crash loop — ap-southeast-1
description: Notification-worker pods on ap-southeast-1 are crash-looping. Each restart lasts less than 30 seconds before the pod fails again. The root cause is notify-cluster-5 being in an overload state — the workers cannot reach the cluster coordinator. Over 200,000 pending notifications are stuck in queue.

title: NotifyHub push gateway returning 504 — notify-cluster-5 root cause
description: Engineering SRE team has traced the push notification 504 errors back to notify-cluster-5 in ap-southeast-1. The cluster is rejecting connections due to resource exhaustion. All three notification delivery channels (push, SMS, email-trigger) are affected. This is a shared cluster-level outage.

title: Training request — notification system for new support team members
description: We have four new members joining the customer support team next week. Please schedule a training session on using the NotifyHub admin panel to manage notification templates and opt-out lists. A 1-hour session would suffice. Preferred timeslot is Monday or Tuesday afternoon.

title: Minor config drift on notify-cluster-5 — low-impact rate limit tweak
description: During a routine audit, we noticed the rate limit configuration on notify-cluster-5 drifted slightly from the standard baseline (2000 req/s vs expected 2048 req/s). This is a very low-impact discrepancy with no user-facing effect. Flagging for the next maintenance window to realign config.
